reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected posture; nothing is being raised against the counterparty.

The cited text supports the conclusion: § 6.0 obliges IBM (us) to purchase only ordered Products and does not authorize MSL to produce or deliver absent an order; § 6.1 permits cancellation of any and all Purchase Orders at any time — i.e., fees follow ordered volumes, the preferred position.

No take-or-pay, minimum volume, or shortfall penalty language appears in the cited paragraphs; volume-related exposure is expressly limited (p0927 'IBM will have no liability for unused flexibility'; p0930 EOL inventory remains MSL's sole responsibility; p0903 no liability for MSL-purchased inventory subject to forecast accuracy).

The Appendix 2 requirements-accuracy compensation is correctly characterized as a quantified, quarterly forecast true-up (percentage of material cost of volume shipped) rather than a multi-year shortfall penalty, so it sits within the rule's fallback/true-up concept at worst; the uncapped nature is properly noted in the rationale rather than flagged as a deviation.
Deterministic checks are empty and no edits were made, consistent with a compliant classification retained as internal evidence.
